title: Viva Engage: community feeds default to all posts, sorted by recent posts
summary: The feed defaults, sticky preferences and rollout information agree with Microsoft's notice and the roadmap. Two minor corrections remain: acknowledge the published Viva Engage Core licensing and describe rollout completion as expected rather than guaranteed.

claims.claim: This change is roadmap item 513275.

claims.claim: The change concerns Microsoft Viva Engage community feeds.
claims.quote: "title": "Microsoft Viva: Engage Community feed improvements"

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the aim as aligning the community feed default with expected user behaviours.
claims.quote: Align the community feeds default experience with expected user behaviors

claims.claim: The roadmap describes support for triage and content review for users who want to read every community message.
claims.quote: support triage and content review for users who want to read every message in a community.

claims.claim: The roadmap gives no preview date.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls

claims.claim: Current unread indicators exist only in the new feed.
claims.quote: Unread indicators on content only exist in the "new" feed.

claims.claim: The new experience retains unread indicators in the new feed.
claims.quote: Unread indicators will exist in both the "new" and "all" feeds.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: A user's chosen feed, new or all, persists across their communities.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls

claims.claim: That fallback visit does not change the user's saved new preference.
claims.quote: but "new" will remain the preference for that user.

claims.claim: Users can still choose the current recent-activity sorting and new-conversation filtering.
claims.quote: alongside the current system, for those who prefer sorting by recent activity and filtering to new conversations only.

Opened Engage service description, setup and Teams experiences; none documents this change.

claims.quote: Viva Engage experiences in Teams include communities and storylines. Both are enabled by default across your organization, and each has its own setting so it can be disabled independently in Teams.
